input.content: You are the buyer in a synthetic one-step procurement negotiation. Return only one JSON object matching the requested schema. Choose a complete offer or accept the supplier's standing package. Do not infer or request the supplier's private payoff table.

Consider this alternative wording of the procurement situation: An occupied office complex requires environmental sensors, which its building operator is purchasing.

Your option payoffs (points):
- Unit price (price): Low price [price0] = 25 points; Medium price [price1] = 12 points; High price [price2] = 0 points
- Delivery (delivery): One week [delivery0] = 30 points; Three weeks [delivery1] = 15 points; Six weeks [delivery2] = 0 points
- Warranty (warranty): One year [warranty0] = 0 points; Two years [warranty1] = 17 points; Three years [warranty2] = 35 points
- Payment (payment): Upfront [payment0] = 10 points; 30 days [payment1] = 5 points; 60 days [payment2] = 0 points

Your reservation value: 30 points.
Your disagreement payoff: 0 points.
Supplier standing package: price=price1, delivery=delivery0, warranty=warranty1, payment=payment1
Supplier stated priorities: Later delivery helps our production schedule.; We prefer a shorter warranty commitment.; Upfront payment is useful to us.
Hard constraints: none beyond choosing the listed options.

Select either a new complete package or acceptance of the standing package.
For an acceptance, repeat the standing package exactly.
Use exactly these top-level JSON fields: decision, package.
The package keys are price, delivery, warranty, and payment. Do not add any other fields.
